entities.name: Redshift
entities.description: A brash goblin test pilot and co-captain of the Goblin Rocketeers in the 2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Goblin Rocketeers
entities.description: Goblin racing team co-captained by Redshift and Daretti.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: Co-captain of the Goblin Rocketeers whom Redshift abandoned during the race.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who mind controlled Redshift while trying to recover his adopted child Loot.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: Site of the third leg of the Grand Prix where saurid raiders laid a trap.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The race in which the Goblin Rocketeers competed.

events.summary: The Rocketeers lead for three legs, but in the third leg through Muraganda they are the first to cross a trap laid by saurid raiders.
events.quote: they were the first to cross a trap laid on the course by saurid raiders

events.summary: Redshift abandons his co-captain Daretti, putting victory over all other interests.
In the final stage Redshift's vehicle is wrecked and Jace Beleren mind controls him.
events.quote: his vehicle was wrecked, and he was mind controlled by Jace Beleren

relations.note: Jace mind controlled him while seeking Loot.
relations.quote: he was mind controlled by Jace Beleren
